Core message

Who you attract isn't about what you know. It's about your emotional state around love.

From the Messaging Center. Every idea is built on it.

Posts for members who've already joined and get it. A good week mixes about two value posts (philosophy, teaching), a few engagement and accountability posts, and one wins or recognition post. The biggest drop-off is in the first two weeks, so lean on "What's normal" and "Welcome" posts for new members.

Popular meme templates that show the old belief (learn everything first) next to the new one (get into the right emotional state). Pick a template and where it's going, and you get the text for each panel. Make it free in Imgflip or Canva. The joke is on the old approach, never the person.

Reels show you can help them. Stories show you understand them. Keep both going so people neither friend-zone you nor feel intimidated.
